question: Hello, Odacchi! There's something I noticed. Katakuri isn't supposed to eat in front of people, yet in volume 86, in the 3rd panel of the 3rd page of Chapter 861, he eats something. Looking closely, there's a bite mark.
answer: Good job finding that~ (laughs) Yes. It's not that Katakuri doesn't eat in front of people. He doesn't let other people see him eat. Now let me show you. Could you see it!? You couldn't see it. He wasn't born with a split mouth. Actually this speed has a source cause, but... I might reveal that in the main story, I'm still thinking about it.
name: Minamimaru
